easyPrerequisites:
O'aka doesn't have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, enter with -1/-1 counter(s) on it or have base toughness 1 or less.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the additional creature
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station and Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from the additional creature, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
